why: Phase A: replace the scaffold placeholders in upgrade-planner overview, domains index and standards index with content from the repo.

ops.body: Upgrade Planner is an Oxygen Not Included mod that adds a toolbar tool for rebuilding the buildings in a box-dragged area. It changes the material of one building type (every sandstone tile, ladder or pipe rebuilt in granite) or replaces one type with another the game lets you build over it (plain pipes to insulated, insulated to plain, modded pipes included). The mod reads the game's own replacement rules and queues the same replacement order the build tool would, once per matching building, keeping each building's orientation. It has a Change material tab, a type tab and presets. It requires Blueprints Expanded by Sgt_Imalas, which keeps an upgraded building's settings and makes every building available to the Change material tab. Version 0.5.0. Targets the current game with all DLC content (minimumSupportedBuild 744825).

- `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`: player-facing description and release notes.
- `src/UpgradePlanner/`: the mod. `Mod.cs` (entry point), `Patches.cs` (Harmony patches), `ModStrings.cs` (UI strings), `mod.yaml` and `mod_info.yaml` (manifests).
- `src/UpgradePlanner/Tool/`: the tool and the order queue (`UpgradeTool.cs`, `PlacementQueue.cs`, `Orders.cs`, `WindowToggle.cs`).
- `src/UpgradePlanner/Plan/`: plans and presets (`UpgradePlan.cs`, `ChangeMaterialPlan.cs`, `ReplaceTypePlan.cs`, `Presets.cs`).
- `src/UpgradePlanner/Rules/`: replacement rules, families, variants and materials.
- `src/UpgradePlanner/UI/`: the planner dialog, tabs, material picker, preset bar, hover card and tool icon.
- `src/UpgradePlanner/Compat/`: Blueprints Expanded link and settings handling for other mods (`BlueprintsCompat.cs`, `ModCompat.cs`, `OtherModSettings.cs`).
- `src/UpgradePlanner/translations/`: `.pot` template and `ko`, `ru`, `zh` po files.
- `src/UpgradePlanner.Tests/`: in-game tests, with its own `README.md`.
- `lib/PLib/`: the PLib copy the mod builds against.
- `preview/`: preview image sources; `publish/`: Workshop description, tags, preview image and workshop id.
- `.context/`: `overview.md`, `domains/` ([entities](domains/entities.md), [glossary](domains/glossary.md)), `standards/` ([code-style](standards/code-style.md), [error-handling](standards/error-handling.md), [naming-conventions](standards/naming-conventions.md)), `decisions/`, `retrospectives/`, `META.md`, `projects.md`.

- [entities](entities.md): the planner tool, its plans and rules, the order queue and the Blueprints Expanded link.
- [glossary](glossary.md): game and mod terms, abbreviations and terms to avoid.

- [code-style](code-style.md): C# formatting, imports, comments, Harmony patch and component conventions, with this mod's own layout.
- [error-handling](error-handling.md): how the mod guards its Harmony patches, reflection lookups and file reads, and what it logs when something is missing.
- [naming-conventions](naming-conventions.md): file, namespace, patch class, string key and id naming.
